# Quarantine StoreUpdateRowsNL's animation-mark check while #21135 finds its cause

## Context

dev's e2e engine tier is red at `a29510a067` (run 43872820052, shard 12/14) on one check of `test/playwright/e2e/grid/StoreUpdateRowsNL.spec.mjs`: "each changed counter cell was marked" receives `[]`. The same check failed today on neo #21087, #21044 and #21118, and none of them touch grid code. A re-run of #21087's shard passed.

Every dev-based PR inherits the red as repair-ci work its author cannot do. The cause is tracked in #21135.

## The Problem

Until #21135 finds the cause, the check fails a share of PR runs. The spec's other assertions pass in every failing run:
- the batched values on the three visible rows;
- `missing` stays empty, so the off-screen rows are rows of the store;
- the scroll position is unchanged.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority: n/a — a test change; it calls no engine behavior wrong.`
- The mark check (the spec's `expect.poll(marked, …)`) is the only assertion that reads a transient class, `neo-animated`, which the row's next repaint removes again.

## The Fix

Record the observed marks as a test annotation that names #21135, instead of asserting them. Keep every other assertion. #21135 restores the assertion.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The spec passes in CI, and the run's report carries the recorded marks with #21135.
- [ ] The values, `missing` and scroll assertions are unchanged.

## Out of Scope

Finding the cause (#21135).
